label: Field definition
description: The definition of one field of an entity (FieldSpec): a stable key, a field type (one of the field.<type> elements), a label, and the constraint props that apply to that type, plus flags such as required, readOnly, hidden, deprecated, and system. Views place fields with the field element; this spec defines what the field is everywhere.
usage: Pick the most specific type (email, user, lookup) rather than short_text.
Write a label people say out loud and put guidance in help.
Prefix tenant-added keys with tenant__; never reuse a key that was deprecated.
constraints: type must be one of the field types; type-specific props are validated against field.<type>'s propsSchema and props that do not apply to the type are rejected.
key is unique within the entity and immutable; changing type means adding a new field and migrating with a convert migration (expand, backfill, contract).
required and readOnly here are data-level and enforced on every write path; system fields are never writable through the record API.
Fields are hidden or deprecated, never deleted, so existing values are kept.
